meaning:
πλανήτης, -ου, ὁ
(πλανάω), [in LXX: Hos.9:17 (נָדַד) * ;]
= πλάνης, a wanderer: ἀστέρες π. (cl. planets), wandering stars, Ju 13 (WH, mg., -τες).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: wild waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, for whom the blackness of darkness has been reserved forever.
